name: discord-moderation-bot
description: Discord moderation bot with admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BOT,API,WEB -c blue,green,magenta "npm run bot:dev" "npm run api:dev" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd bot && npm install && cd ../api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
